automation.title: Automation
paragraphs: A smart home should make the house simpler, not add more apps. That's why we connect lighting, shading, heating and air conditioning, audio and video, security and home access into one system you control from a wall panel, a keypad by the door or your phone.

We work with Crestron, Loxone and Lutron. We choose Crestron for large villas and projects that connect dozens of zones and technologies from different manufacturers. Loxone is a more affordable option for family homes and apartments. Lutron offers premium lighting and shading control. We recommend the system based on the size of your home, your needs and your budget.

We do all the programming ourselves, so scenes and automations match how you actually live: in the morning the lights slowly come up and the blinds open, when you leave everything switches off and the alarm arms, and in the evening one button gets the living room ready for a film. We handle design, installation, programming and long-term service across the Czech Republic and abroad.

av.title: Audio/Video
paragraphs: Music in every room, a home cinema, or a TV that disappears from the wall when you don't need it. We design and install audio and video systems that sound and look great without spoiling the interior: speakers built into ceilings and walls, TVs mounted flush, and cabling hidden in the walls.

For multiroom audio we use Sonos and Bowers & Wilkins speakers; for home cinema, Denon and Marantz receivers and LG TVs. Listen to something different in each room, or play the same music through the whole house and out onto the terrace. We set up and calibrate home cinema sound for the specific room, not by the book.

We connect the whole system to a Crestron or Loxone smart home. One press of the "Cinema" scene closes the blinds, dims the lights, turns on the projector and starts the film. Instead of a pile of remotes, one panel or your phone is all you need.

network.title: Síťová infrastruktura
paragraphs: Chytrá domácnost, kamery i streamování ve 4K stojí na jednom základu: spolehlivé síti. Navrhujeme a stavíme datové rozvody pro rodinné domy, vily i firmy, od strukturované kabeláže a optiky přes rozvaděč s rackem až po Wi-Fi, které pokryje celý dům včetně zahrady a garáže.

Pracujeme hlavně s UniFi od Ubiquiti, protože síť, Wi-Fi, kamery UniFi Protect i přístupový systém UniFi Access spravujete z jedné aplikace. Pro specifické projekty nasazujeme také MikroTik a Cisco. Rozmístění přístupových bodů plánujeme podle půdorysu a materiálů stavby, aby signál nebyl jen „někde“, ale všude, kde ho potřebujete.

Na bezpečnost myslíme od začátku: chytrá domácnost, kamery a hosté mají v síti oddělené segmenty (VLAN), za firewallem a se zabezpečeným vzdáleným přístupem přes VPN. Síť monitorujeme a díky vzdálené správě vyřešíme většinu problémů dřív, než si jich všimnete.

hero.heading: Smart lighting for villas and family homes
hero.subheading: We design and install Crestron, Lutron and Loxone lighting control. Lighting scenes, smooth dimming and automation based on presence and daylight, without a row of switches on every wall.
hero.imgAlt: Smart living room lighting with hidden LED strips and lighting scenes

intro.heading: Light that adapts to you
paragraphs: Good lighting isn't just about whether it's on. It's about how much light a room gets, what colour it is and when it changes. Smart lighting control connects every light in your home into one system, so instead of ten switches you press one button and the whole room sets itself.

We work with three of the most reliable systems on the market: Crestron, Lutron and Loxone. Each has different strengths, so we choose based on the size of your home, your needs and your budget, not on one brand.

section1.heading: Lighting scenes at the touch of a button
paragraphs: A scene is a saved setting for every light in a room. "Dinner" dims the ceiling lights and keeps the pendant over the table on, "Cinema" turns off everything except soft backlighting and closes the blinds, "Cleaning" turns everything up to full. You start scenes from a designer keypad on the wall, a touch panel or your phone.
We set scenes up around how you actually use your home, and we can adjust them at any time later without touching the wiring.
section1.imgAlt: Wall keypad for controlling lighting scenes

section2.heading: Automation based on presence and daylight
paragraphs: Presence sensors turn on the lights in the hallway, walk-in wardrobe or garage when you walk in and turn them off when you leave. Daylight sensors adjust brightness to the light coming through the windows, so the room always feels comfortable and no energy is wasted.
At night, the path to the bathroom lights up only dimly so it doesn't dazzle you, and a "Goodnight" button by the bed turns off the whole house and makes sure nothing is left on.
section2.imgAlt: Presence sensor and automatic hallway lighting

section3.heading: Circadian lighting that follows the day
paragraphs: Tunable white fixtures change the colour of light during the day: cooler, fresher light in the morning, shifting to warm tones in the evening that won't keep you up before bed. It all happens automatically, based on the time of day.
Circadian lighting works especially well in bedrooms, studies and children's rooms. We choose suitable fixtures and set the colour curve around your daily rhythm.
section3.imgAlt: Warm evening light and cool daylight in an interior

section4.heading: Hidden LED and architectural lighting
paragraphs: In luxury interiors you don't see the fixture, you see the light. LED strips hidden in ceiling coves, shadow gaps, niches or under stairs create soft indirect light that brings out the architecture and materials.
We work with architects and interior designers from the design stage to plan the profiles, power supplies and cabling properly. That way the result looks as intended, not like an afterthought.
section4.imgAlt: Hidden LED lighting in a ceiling cove and shadow gap

section5.heading: Less energy, longer lifespan
paragraphs: Smart control saves energy naturally: lights don't stay on in empty rooms, brightness adapts to daylight, and one button turns everything off when you leave the house. Dimmed LED fixtures also run at a lower load and last longer.

section6.heading: Crestron, Lutron, Loxone and DALI: which system to choose
section6.intro: All three systems handle lighting scenes, dimming and automation. They differ in scale, integration options and price.

items.name: Crestron
items.text: The best choice for large villas where lighting is connected with audio, video, shading, climate and security in one system. It handles dozens of zones and works with DALI fixtures and other technologies from different manufacturers. We design the controls around you, including custom touch panel graphics.

items.name: Lutron
items.text: A lighting and shading specialist, known for exceptionally smooth, flicker-free dimming and elegant keypads. Its wireless options also suit finished homes where you don't want to open walls for new cabling.

items.name: Loxone
items.text: A more affordable option for family homes and apartments. It controls lighting together with heating, shading and security from one app. The wireless Loxone Air range lets you add lights and buttons without new cables.

items.name: DALI
items.text: An open standard for digital lighting control. Every fixture has its own address, so its brightness and colour can be controlled individually. We connect DALI with Crestron, Loxone and other systems, which makes it ideal for demanding projects and commercial spaces.

faqs.q: What is smart lighting and how is it different from regular lighting?
faqs.a: Regular lighting is switched on and off. Smart lighting is run by a central system that can dim, store lighting scenes, react to presence and daylight, and be controlled from a keypad, a panel or your phone.

faqs.q: Can smart lighting be added to an existing home?
faqs.a: Yes. In finished homes we often use wireless systems such as Lutron or Loxone Air, which don't need new cabling. During a renovation it's best to lay cables right away, because a wired system is the most reliable.

faqs.q: What is DALI and do I need it?
faqs.a: DALI is a standard for digital lighting control in which every fixture has its own address. It's useful when you want to control the brightness and colour of individual fixtures or plan a larger lighting installation. Smaller homes are often fine with regular dimmers; we recommend the right solution during design.

faqs.q: Crestron, Lutron or Loxone: which is best for my home?
faqs.a: Crestron suits larger villas where lighting is connected with other technologies. Lutron is a leader in lighting and shading control. Loxone is a more affordable choice for family homes. We recommend a system based on the size of your home, your needs and your budget.

faqs.q: Does lighting control work without the internet?
faqs.a: Yes. Crestron, Lutron and Loxone all control lighting locally in your home, so keypads, scenes and automations keep working during an internet outage. You only need the internet for remote control.

faqs.q: How much does smart lighting cost?
faqs.a: It depends on the size of the house, the number of zones, the system and the fixtures. A few rooms with Loxone are a very different budget from a whole villa with Crestron and DALI. After a free initial consultation, we prepare a design and an indicative budget.

homeAccess.subtitle: We design and install keyless entry, video intercoms and gate control integrated with Crestron and Loxone smart homes. See who's arriving and open the door from anywhere.
homeAccess.heading: Access control
homeAccess.imgAlt: Entrance of a modern home with a smart lock and access control system

intro.heading: Keyless entry to your home
paragraphs: Keys get lost, copied and lent out. A smart access system replaces them with a code, a fob or your phone, and you know exactly who entered and when.
We connect the front door, garden gate, driveway gate and garage into one system that's part of your smart home. Unlocking can also light the path to the door or disarm the alarm.

section1.heading: Smart locks and keyless entry
paragraphs: Unlock the door with a code, a fob, a card or your phone. Family members have permanent access, while guests, cleaners or tradespeople get a temporary code that works only on the chosen day and time, then stops working on its own.
If someone loses a fob, we simply block it. No changing locks and no copying keys.
section1.imgAlt: Smart lock and fob reader at the front door

section2.heading: Video intercom
paragraphs: When someone rings, you see them on the touch panel inside and on your phone, wherever you are. You can talk to them and open the door or gate with one button, for example for a courier when you're not home.
We connect the intercom to the camera system, so every visit is recorded and easy to find later.
section2.imgAlt: Touch panel showing the video intercom at the entrance

section3.heading: Gates, garage doors and driveways
paragraphs: Control the driveway gate, garden gate and garage doors from your phone, a remote or a panel in the house. The panel shows whether the gate is open, and you can close it from the other side of the world.
Gate access is set up just like door access: every family member or staff member has their own permissions, and the system logs every entry.
section3.imgAlt: Automatic driveway gate controlled from a phone

section4.heading: Connected to your smart home
paragraphs: Access is most convenient when it works with the rest of the house. When you arrive and unlock, the alarm disarms, the hallway lights up and the heating comes on. When you leave, just lock up and the house switches to "Away" mode by itself.
We connect access systems with Crestron and Loxone, so entry, lighting, security and climate are all controlled from one place.

section5.heading: Overview and security
paragraphs: The app shows the history of every entry and alerts you when a door opens at an unusual time. You can change or revoke permissions at any time, even remotely.
We design the system to keep working during an internet outage, with a backup for power cuts. You can always get in.

items.name: Loxone

faqs.q: Can a smart lock be fitted to my existing door?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. There are locks and door hardware that fit existing doors without replacing the whole door or running complex cabling. We recommend the right option based on your door and lock type.

faqs.q: What happens during a power cut or internet outage?
faqs.a: Locks and readers work locally, so an internet outage doesn't affect entry; only remote control is temporarily unavailable. For power cuts we design backup power or a mechanical override, so you can always get in.

faqs.q: Can I give guests or cleaners temporary access?
faqs.a: Yes. You create a code or mobile key that works only on selected days and hours. It stops working on its own when it expires, and the history shows when it was used.

faqs.q: Can the video intercom be connected to my phone?
faqs.a: Yes. You answer the doorbell on your phone, see who's at the door, talk to them and open the door or gate from anywhere.

faqs.q: Is a smart lock more secure than a regular key?
faqs.a: A quality electronic lock can't be opened with a copied key, a lost fob can be blocked instantly, and you have a record of every entry. Proper installation and a secure network matter, and we take care of both from the design stage.

faqs.q: How much does an access control system for a home cost?
faqs.a: It depends on the number of entrances, the type of locks, the intercom and whether we connect the system to your smart home. After a free initial consultation, we prepare a design and an indicative budget.

faqs.q: When should smart wiring be planned in a development project?
faqs.a: Ideally in the design phase. Specifying the cabling and system topology before construction avoids costly retrofits and keeps the per-unit price predictable.

faqs.q: How does automation lower the cost of a build?
faqs.a: Loxone Tree uses a single free-form bus instead of star wiring, cutting cabling effort by up to 80% versus a classic new-build installation. One integrated system also replaces several separate ones, reducing material and the number of trades on site.

faqs.q: Do you provide project documentation and inspections?
faqs.a: Yes. We deliver design drawings, standards, material take-offs, ČSN inspection reports and full handover documentation, and coordinate with the building's MEP, construction and IT.

faqs.q: What does smart automation cost per unit?
faqs.a: It depends on the scope and tier. We define a repeatable standard per unit type, so you get a fixed per-unit price that scales predictably across the whole building.

faqs.q: Can one system scale across different unit types?
faqs.a: Yes. The same platform runs from a studio to a penthouse — you only pay for the scope each unit needs, with a consistent standard across the project.

faqs.q: Can buyers extend or customise their unit after moving in?
faqs.a: Yes. Loxone Air adds wireless devices without construction work, so residents can expand lighting, sensors or controls later without new cabling.

faqs.q: Does the system support energy metering and remote readings?
faqs.a: Yes. We integrate energy monitoring and remote meter readings for heat, hot and cold water — increasingly relevant as EU and Czech regulation moves toward mandatory remote metering in new buildings.

faqs.q: Do you coordinate with the construction schedule and other trades?
faqs.a: Yes. We work in phases alongside the build — design, rough-in, fit-out, configuration, inspection and handover — and coordinate directly with the other professions on site.

faqs.q: Does automation help units sell?
faqs.a: Smart features are increasingly expected in new builds and help differentiate units, support premium pricing and appeal to energy-conscious buyers.

faqs.q: Where do you work?
faqs.a: Across the Czech Republic and the wider EU, for residential developments, apartment buildings and commercial projects.

forArchitects.subheading: We work with architects from the early concept stage so lighting, shading, audio/video and climate control are planned into the design instead of added on top of it.

faqs.q: When should an architect involve a smart home integrator?
faqs.a: Ideally at the concept or feasibility stage. Niches for shading, cable routes, the technical room and ceiling void depths can then be built into the design, which avoids costly changes on site and keeps your design intent intact.

faqs.q: What drawings do you need for a first proposal?
faqs.a: Floor plans, sections, your interior concept and the client's wishes for how the home should be controlled are enough to start. We accept PDF, DWG or BIM, and we can begin from an early-stage concept.

faqs.q: Do you work with BIM and DWG files?
faqs.a: Yes. We add the system design, cable routes, control point locations and technical room layout to your drawings, so everything stays consistent with your project.

faqs.q: Can you coordinate with our interior designer?
faqs.a: Yes. We coordinate the placement of keypads, speakers, screens and light fittings with you and the interior designer, so the technology fits the overall design.

faqs.q: Can the technology be hidden so it doesn't affect the interior?
faqs.a: Yes. We use concealed in-ceiling speakers, hidden screens and projection, integrated shading and lighting with no visible hardware. The key is planning them early, ideally at the design stage.

faqs.q: Crestron, Loxone or Lutron: what should we recommend to the client?
faqs.a: Crestron suits large, demanding villas that need maximum customization. Lutron excels at premium lighting and shading control. Loxone is a cost-efficient choice for small to mid-size homes. We help you choose based on the project scale, budget and the client's requirements.

faqs.q: Do you provide documentation, testing and handover?
faqs.a: Yes. We deliver technical documentation, material lists, inspection reports per Czech standards (ČSN) and full handover documentation. We also test and commission the system and train the client before handover.

faqs.q: Who services the system after handover?
faqs.a: We do. We offer warranty and post-warranty service, remote management and technical support, so your client always has a single point of contact.

faqs.q: Do you work outside the Czech Republic?
faqs.a: Yes. We work across the Czech Republic, throughout the EU and beyond, on villas, luxury residences and commercial projects. Send us your project details and we will confirm how we can support it.

faqs.q: Is Loxone better than traditional smart home systems?
faqs.a: Loxone focuses on true automation rather than simple remote control, reducing the need for manual interaction.

faqs.q: Can Loxone integrate with solar panels?
faqs.a: Yes. Loxone supports advanced energy management and solar integration.

crestronIntegration.subheading: Experience complete control of your home through one intelligent platform. Crestron seamlessly integrates lighting, climate, security, entertainment, shading, and access control into a single luxury smart home experience.

section1.heading: Why Choose Crestron?
description: Crestron is one of the world's most trusted automation platforms for luxury homes, premium residences, and intelligent buildings.
Designed to deliver reliability, performance, and exceptional user experience, Crestron brings every system in your property together under one intuitive interface.
Unlike standalone smart devices, Crestron provides a fully integrated ecosystem that simplifies daily living while enhancing comfort, security, and efficiency.

section3.heading: Custom touch panel design
paragraphs: Most Crestron installations use the same ready-made templates. We design the controls around you instead: wall touch panels, tablets and the phone app look like part of your interior, not like a technical display.

We match the graphics to the colours, materials and style of your home. The screen layout follows how you actually use the house: scenes and home cinema at hand in the living room, night mode and blinds in the bedroom, the alarm and gate camera by the entrance. We hide what you don't need, so even children or grandparents find it easy.

We show you the design on screen first, adjust it to your feedback, and only then program it. The controls can be in Czech, English or other languages, so the whole family, guests and staff can use them.
list: Design matched to your interior and style

Simplified mode for children, grandparents and guests

section7.heading: Integrating third-party devices
paragraphs: Not every device in your home comes with a ready-made Crestron driver. Air conditioners, battery storage, solar inverters and access systems often use their own protocols, so many integrators leave them out, and you end up controlling them in a separate app.

We write our own modules for these devices, so you control them like the rest of your home: set the air conditioning from the panel in every room, see your battery level and solar production, and get door entry and intercom calls right on the touch panel.
Not sure if a device in your home can work with Crestron? Send us the brand and model, and we'll check.
list: Air conditioners and heat pumps over Modbus
Battery storage and solar inverters
UniFi Access entry systems and intercoms
Devices with TCP/IP, RS-232 or RS-485 interfaces
Modules also available to other integrators

faqs.q: What is Crestron Home?
faqs.a: Crestron Home is a premium automation platform that connects lighting, climate, entertainment, security, and shading into one intelligent system.

faqs.q: Is Crestron suitable for luxury homes?
faqs.a: Yes. Crestron is widely used in luxury residential projects, villas, penthouses, and premium developments worldwide.

faqs.q: Can Crestron integrate with existing systems?
faqs.a: In many cases, yes. Crestron supports integration with a wide range of third-party technologies.

faqs.q: Can I control my home remotely?
faqs.a: Yes. Crestron allows secure remote access through mobile devices.

faqs.q: Is Crestron better than multiple smart home apps?
faqs.a: Crestron's advantage is centralization. Instead of managing numerous apps, users control all systems from one platform.

showroom.title: Smart Home Showroom
description: We're exploring several directions – a branded showroom in partnership with manufacturers such as Samsung, a professional audio recording studio, and a multi-purpose shared space combining smart home and commercial integration. We're choosing the concept that delivers the most value to our clients across the EU.

Until the showroom opens, our specialists will design a solution tailored precisely to your home or project. During a no-obligation consultation, we'll walk you through system integration, budget, and installation – clearly and without pressure.
Want to be among the first to see it? Get in touch and we'll keep you informed about the showroom launch and the latest in intelligent living for homes across Europe.

office.title: Smart Office & Workspace
description: Turn your workplace into a productive, professional environment. P&A Vision unifies meeting room booking, video conferencing, DALI lighting, shading, climate, and audio/video into a single system that adapts to how your team actually works.

Your team books a room with one tap and the space prepares itself – Zoom or Microsoft Teams launches on the room display, the projection or screen comes down, microphones and speakers activate, and DALI-controlled lighting sets the right scene while blinds adjust to kill glare on camera. A panel by the door shows at a glance whether the room is free or busy, so meetings never overlap.

Run seamless video conferences with automatic camera framing and calibrated room audio – no fiddling with the tech before every call. DALI addressable lighting gives you tunable white and human-centric scenes per fixture, presentation and focus presets, plus per-luminaire dimming that cuts energy use. Combined with efficient climate control, running costs drop while comfort stays high – all monitored and controlled from one place.

We design and deliver meeting room booking, video conferencing, professional audio, and DALI lighting solutions for offices and corporate spaces across the EU. Reliably, elegantly, and with attention to detail.

familyHome.title: Smart Family Home
description: A home that adapts to you and the way you live.

P&A Vision connects lighting, heating, air conditioning, shading, security and home entertainment into one easy-to-use system. We work with proven Crestron, Loxone and Lutron technologies, which let us design solutions for everything from family homes to large luxury residences. For more demanding projects we mainly use Crestron, which offers extensive integration options, high reliability and convenient control of the entire home.
Comfort you don't have to think about.

Lighting adapts to the time of day, blinds respond to sunlight and the temperature adjusts automatically to the needs of each room. With a single button, you can set the house for a relaxing evening, a film or leaving for work. Smart automation makes everyday life more pleasant and helps reduce energy consumption. Thanks to the flexibility of the systems we use, even large properties with dozens of separate zones are easy to control.
Security and control, wherever you are.

Keep your cameras, alarm system, entrance gate and smart locks under control straight from your phone. Check at any time what's happening around the house, who's at the door or whether everything is properly secured. Whether you're at work, on holiday or on the other side of the world, you always know what's going on at home.
A solution designed just for you.

We design, install and program smart home systems for family homes and luxury villas across Europe. From simple automation to complete Crestron solutions that connect every technology in the house, each project is tailored to your requirements, the character of your property and your budget.

business.title: Smart Solutions for Business & Commercial Spaces
description: From hotels and restaurants to retail and showrooms – P&A Vision delivers professional automation and network infrastructure for commercial spaces. Structured cabling, Wi-Fi networks, CCTV and security systems, and access control work together as one reliable whole.

A dependable network is the foundation of every operation. We design and build network infrastructure with security at its core – network segmentation, firewall, monitoring, and backup – and connect it with cameras, access systems, and alarms in a single clear interface.

Cut electricity consumption through smart energy management – automatic shutdown of devices, plus lighting and climate control based on occupancy and schedule. You get real-time visibility into costs, and the system scales as your business grows.
We design and integrate networks, security, and energy-saving solutions for businesses across the EU – with a focus on reliability, safety, and a professional appearance.
